tutorial.history.title: Nhoroondo yekutaura
tutorial.history.body: Iyi ndiyo nhoroondo yako yekutaura. Yakapfuura AVNIVO nhaurirano neshanduro dzakachengetwa pano. Unogona kuvhurazve nekudzokorora hurukuro dzekare kana kutanga imwe itsva.
tutorial.settings.title: Zvirongwa
tutorial.settings.body: Gadzirisa mashandiro anoita muturikiri pano. Zvirongwa zvepamhepo zvinosanganisira kutamba kwekutaura, manzwi, toni uye masitaera. Masetin'i epasina Indaneti anoratidza kudhaunirodwa matauriro, kududzira uye mamodule ekutamba ekutaura uye chimiro chawo. Zvimiro zvinoenderana neyakasarudzwa modhi uye yakaiswa modules.
tutorial.microphone.title: Maikorofoni
tutorial.microphone.body: Shandisa maikorofoni kushandura mutauro. Sarudza mitauro yako, baya maikorofoni uye taura zvakajairika. Kuzivikanwa kwekutaura kunoenderana nesarudzo yakasarudzwa. Bhurawuza maikorofoni mvumo inogona kudiwa.
tutorial.online.title: Maitiro epaIndaneti
tutorial.online.body: Bhatani iri rinosarudza shanduro ine Indaneti. Pamhepo modhi inogona kushandisa inowanikwa gore rinozivikanwa kutaura uye masevhisi ekushandura. Kubatana kweinternet uye kuwana masevhisi kunodiwa. Iyo app parizvino inovhura muOnline mode.
tutorial.offline.title: Maitiro ekushanda usiri paIndaneti
tutorial.offline.body: Iri bhatani rinosarudza maitiro akagadzirirwa kushandiswa pasina internet. Dhawunirodha inodiwa mutauro nemamodule ekutaura pachine nguva. Mitauro iripo uye maitiro zvinoenderana nemamodule akaiswa. Tinya Kunzwisisa kupedzisa sumo uye kuvhura iyo app.
